reason: The list_directory tool provides a list of file and directory paths, which an agent can use to identify a specific file to read with read_text_file.
The list_directory_with_sizes tool provides a list of file and directory paths, including sizes, which an agent can use to identify a specific file to read with read_text_file.
The search_files tool returns paths of files that match a given pattern, directly providing the path needed by read_text_file.
